name: Slice Engineering 450°C
description: The Slice Engineering 450°C thermistor is a specially designed high-temperature NTC thermistor intended for use in the Slice Engineering Mosquito and Copperhead hotends. It is rated for continuous operation up to 450°C, enabling reliable temperature measurement for high-temperature filaments such as PEEK, PEI, and other engineering materials. Klipper supports it natively with the 'SliceEngineering 450' sensor type.
